overview_description.description: Contractbook’s contract management software empowers modern businesses to turn manual processes into fully automated workflows. This means anyone can work effortlessly with contracts across the entire lifecycle, regardless of role or familiarity. Create and sign seamlessly. Collaborate with your team. Manage all your documents in one place. And automate the process to achieve efficiency. Funded by investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Gradient Ventures, Contractbook was founded in Copenhagen in 2017 and serves over 250,000 users in more than 85 countries. Learn more about how Contractbook makes working with contracts an easy, efficient, and stress-free experience at www.contractbook.com.

product.name: Contractbook Contract Management Software
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing the entire contract lifecycle, including creation, collaboration, signing, storage, tracking, and automation of contracts.

product.name: Contract Templates and Agreements
product.description: Pre-made, customizable contract templates for various business needs that can be edited, sent for signature, and stored within the platform.

product.name: Automated Document Generation
product.description: A tool that automatically creates personalized documents by merging data with templates to produce ready-to-use contracts and other business documents.

identifier.value: Contract Data Extraction and AI Upload

product.name: Contract Data Extraction and AI Upload
product.description: An AI-powered feature that extracts key data fields from existing contracts and PDFs to make contract information searchable and actionable.

product.name: Contract Automation and Workflow Management
product.description: Software tools to automate contract-related tasks such as approvals, reminders, renewals, and integration with other business systems.
